text:
If you caught sunset tonight, it was a gray one, with the cloud deck holding onto Burlington and a cool 55-degree feel. Skies stay mostly cloudy this evening, then may break a bit overnight, with patchy fog developing after midnight and temperatures settling near 48. The lake should be quiet, with north winds under 10 knots and waves a foot or less, though the 62-degree water will make it feel colder than the air. Air quality is Moderate because of fine particles, so anyone sensitive to that should take it easy outdoors.

Wednesday is the payoff for this cool, cloudy stretch: patchy fog before 7, then a partly sunny sky and a high near 71. The lake stays calm, but a south breeze builds to 5 to 15 knots. Give the shoreline until the fog lifts, then Wednesday afternoon looks like the better window for a walk or paddle.
